title: JPL counter clerk hands over negatives of "the old city on Mars"

tellings.quote: he went oh this is the old city on Mars

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a man who wrote a book called Mind Trek, says that in the 1980s he went to the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, the NASA center in California that runs space probes, and asked for photo negatives from its mapping of Mars. According to him, the clerk at the counter handed them over and said, "oh, this is the old city on Mars." If true, it would mean people inside the lab casually spoke of ruins of a city on Mars.
